panels.title: Gateway Request Rate
panels.description: Requests answered by the gateway per second, every model and endpoint.

panels.title: Gateway Error Fraction
panels.description: Share of requests that ended in a 5xx or a broken stream. A caller hanging up is not an error.

panels.title: Gateway p95 Latency
panels.description: 95% of requests finished within this time, arrival to last byte.

panels.title: Gateway Inflight
panels.description: Requests inside the gateway right now, queued or running.

panels.title: Running Requests
panels.description: Requests a model server is working on right now.

panels.title: Waiting Requests
panels.description: Requests queued in the gateway: every slot is busy, or the GPU is serving the other model.

panels.title: Efficient Routing Share
panels.description: Share of requests in the selected time range that the efficient tier answered.

panels.title: Prompt Throughput
panels.description: Prompt tokens per second, counted when a request ends.

panels.title: Generation Throughput
panels.description: Generated tokens per second, counted when a request ends.

panels.title: Efficient Routed Decisions
panels.description: Requests answered by an efficient-tier model in the selected time range.

panels.title: Capable Routed Decisions
panels.description: Requests answered by a capable-tier model in the selected time range.

panels.title: Gateway Latency
panels.description: Arrival to last byte, all models.

panels.title: Serving Target Health
panels.description: Green (1+): the gateway's health check of the target passed; it checks every 15 s. The first and last rows are Prometheus reaching the gateway and mimir's GPU exporter.

panels.title: TTFT by Model
panels.description: Time to first token of streamed requests, from arrival: queueing and model loading included.

panels.title: p95 Time per Output Token by Model
panels.description: Mean gap between output tokens of a request; 20 ms is 50 tokens/s.

panels.title: End-to-End Latency by Model
panels.description: Arrival to last byte, per model.

panels.title: Request Length Heatmap (Prompt)
panels.description: How long prompts are, in tokens: one cell per size bucket and time step, coloured by request count.

panels.title: Inference Stage Breakdown
panels.description: Mean time a request spends reading the prompt (prefill) and generating (decode). These are llama.cpp's own timings where it reports them.

panels.title: Finish Reason Distribution
panels.description: Why generation ended in the selected time range. abort: the caller hung up. error: the upstream failed.

panels.title: Prompt Tokens
panels.description: Prompt tokens in the selected time range, cached ones included.

panels.title: Generated Tokens
panels.description: Tokens generated in the selected time range.

panels.title: Prompt Cache Share
panels.description: Share of prompt tokens the server took from its prompt cache instead of processing again.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests in the selected time range.

panels.title: Prompt Tokens by Model
panels.description: Prompt tokens per model.

panels.title: Generated Tokens by Model
panels.description: Generated tokens per model.

panels.title: Spend · Last 24 Hours
panels.description: What OpenRouter charged for calls through the gateway in the last 24 hours. It reports the price with every answer; local models cost nothing here.

panels.title: Spend · Last 30 Days
panels.description: The same over 30 days, which is as far back as Prometheus keeps data.

panels.title: Spend · Selected Range
panels.description: The same for the dashboard's time range and Model filter.

panels.title: Tokens by Caller
panels.description: Prompt plus generated tokens per caller. A caller names itself in the URL (/client/<name>/v1); everything else is "other".

panels.title: Requests by Caller
panels.description: Requests per caller.

panels.title: Spend by Caller
panels.description: What each caller's requests cost on OpenRouter.

panels.title: GPU
panels.description: The card nvidia-smi reports on mimir.

panels.title: GPU Utilization
panels.description: How busy the GPU is.

panels.title: VRAM Used
panels.description: Share of the card's memory in use: the loaded chat model plus everything else on the GPU.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: GPU core temperature.

panels.title: Power Draw
panels.description: Power the card is drawing.

panels.title: Fan
panels.description: Fan speed.

panels.title: GPU Utilization and VRAM
panels.description: GPU load and memory use over time.

panels.title: GPU Temperature and Power
panels.description: Core temperature (left axis) and power draw (right axis).

panels.title: Request Lookup
panels.description: The gateway's record of each request: model, tokens, timings. Paste the X-Request-Id of a response into Request ID at the top; clear the box to list every request.
